name: Banco da Amazonia S.A.
summary: Banco da Amazônia S.A. provides banking products and services in the Amazon region of Brazil. The company accepts savings, current, and checking accounts; and offers various loans. It also provides various cards; investment and insurance products; pension plans; and foreign trade and exchange, money order, collection, direct debit, payment, online, and other financial services. Banco da Amazônia S.A. was founded in 1942 and is based in Belém, Brazil.
